# SGEN — Dental Local SEO + AEO

> SGEN is a local search agency working with dental practices. We build map-pack and organic visibility in Google, and make practice websites quotable by ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Claude. One monthly retainer, from $497, no setup fee, cancel any month.

Two separate jobs run under one invoice. The first is position: where a practice sits in Google's organic results and in the Google Maps three-pack for the treatments it wants to fill. The second is inclusion: whether an assistant names that practice at all when a patient asks which dentist nearby is worth booking. SGEN designs and ranks the practice website both jobs depend on. Single-chair practices through to multi-site groups. Billing is monthly through Stripe, with no setup fee and nothing to sign.

## Pages
- [Dental Local SEO + AEO](https://www.sgen.com/dental-local-seo-aeo): the dental landing page — how the work runs, what each tier costs, sample results and the full FAQ.

## Pricing
- Local SEO — $497/month
- Local AEO — $797/month
- SEO + AEO — $1,297/month
Stripe collects the retainer each month. Canceling takes two clicks in the customer portal: no setup fee, no onboarding charge, no exit fee, and everything already built stays on the practice's own domain.

## Method
Six stages: audit and entity mapping across 14 AI surfaces; foundation rebuild (Dentist schema, llms.txt, patient FAQ structures, Google Business Profile, Core Web Vitals); a content engine of 8–24 treatment pages a month; a citation network across local press and the dental directories that carry weight; weekly visibility reporting across Google and the four assistants; then scaling into further locations and treatment lines.

## Specialties served
Implants and full-arch cases, clear aligners and orthodontics, cosmetic work and whitening, gum disease and periodontal care, root canal work, dentures and crown-and-bridge, surgical extractions and oral surgery, children's dentistry, emergency and same-day appointments, and general and family practice.

## Key answers
- How fast does it work? Local rankings usually start moving between day 60 and day 120. Mentions inside ChatGPT, Gemini or Perplexity often arrive sooner, at 30 to 60 days, because answer engines re-crawl faster than Google does.
- Is there a way out? Yes. Stripe bills monthly and the practice cancels itself in the customer portal — no retention call, no exit fee. Every page, post, citation and link already built stays with the practice.
- What is AEO? Answer Engine Optimization. SEO argues for a position in Google's results and in Maps; AEO decides whether an AI assistant names the practice at all.
- Is there a contract? None. Month to month, nothing to set up and nothing to sign.
